subject: english
question: Which of the following is true according to the above passage?

options.text: Since the 1920s, the average life expectancy has steadily decreased in India
In 2019, the average life expectancy in India was roughly 74 years.
India has the fifth largest population in the world
India is home to over 1.3 billion people

solution:
The correct answer is **"India is home to over 1.3 billion people."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the first paragraph:
 
 
• *"With the second-largest population in the world, India is home to over 1.3 billion people."*
 
 
 
• The passage mentions that India's population is over 1.3 billion.

Therefore, the correct answer is:*** India is home to over 1.3 billion people***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 and option 2 are incorrect as it is mentioned in the passage that "The average life expectancy has seen a consistent increase since the 1920s and was around 69 years in 2019."
 
• Option 3 is incorrect as it is nowhere mentioned in the passage.
